Module Compiler Instructions
The Module Compiler can write, extract, copy and enhance effects. Special modules can enable additional functions.\nCheck the machine tooltip to see what it will do next.

Write: Place a recorded disk in the input port and a module with enough free capacity in the target bay, then switch on the machine to write the effect.
Extract: Place a blank disk in the export port and a module with compilable effects in the target bay, then switch on the machine to extract one random effect.
Copy: Place a recorded disk in the input port and a blank disk in the export port. Leave the target bay empty, then switch on the machine to copy the effect.
Enhance: Place disks with the same effect and level in both ports. Leave the target bay empty, then switch on the machine to upgrade the export disk, up to level III.
